domain: sober-event dinner with mocktails and food
base_instruction: You are a helpful event planning assistant. Help the user plan a sober dinner party with mocktails and food. Track who is attending, their dietary needs, and any beverage preferences. When asked to evaluate specific items, check each one against every active guest's current constraints.

ground_truth.answer: Thai peanut noodles: problematic — Nina has a severe peanut allergy. Also problematic for Dev if made with wheat noodles (celiac/gluten). Grilled salmon with cream sauce: problematic — cream sauce contains dairy protein, which Tomoko cannot have. The salmon itself is cooked so it's fine for Rachel. Mushroom risotto with parmesan: problematic — parmesan is dairy, Tomoko cannot have it. Virgin piña colada with coconut cream: fine — coconut cream is not dairy, safe for everyone. Sparkling lavender lemonade: fine — no allergens for current guests. Chocolate mousse with heavy cream: problematic — heavy cream is dairy, Tomoko cannot have it. Marcus's sugar restriction no longer applies since he dropped out.

Grilled salmon with cream sauce is problematic because the cream sauce contains dairy protein and Tomoko has a dairy protein allergy
Mushroom risotto with parmesan is problematic because parmesan is dairy and Tomoko has a dairy protein allergy
Chocolate mousse with heavy cream is problematic because heavy cream is dairy and Tomoko has a dairy protein allergy
Sparkling lavender lemonade is fine for all current guests

forbidden_elements: Flagging high sugar content as a problem for Marcus (Marcus is no longer attending)
Saying Tomoko is only lactose intolerant (her constraint was upgraded to dairy protein allergy)
Flagging coconut cream as a dairy issue for Tomoko (coconut is not dairy)
Flagging grilled salmon as problematic for Rachel due to pregnancy (the salmon is cooked, not raw)
Treating Tomoko's allergy as only lactose intolerance and saying she can have lactose-free dairy
ground_truth.explanation: This scenario tests constraint UPGRADE tracking and entity lifecycle management. Key challenges: (1) Tomoko's constraint is UPGRADED from lactose intolerance to dairy protein allergy — the broader constraint means ALL dairy is off-limits, not just lactose-containing products. Cream, parmesan, and heavy cream all contain dairy protein. (2) Nina joins late (Turn 3) with a severe peanut allergy — the Thai peanut noodles directly violate this. (3) Marcus EXITS (Turn 6) — his diabetes/sugar constraint should be REMOVED, so the agent should NOT flag sugar in mocktails or dessert. (4) Over-generalization trap: coconut cream is NOT dairy despite having 'cream' in the name — the piña colada is safe for Tomoko. (5) Rachel's pregnancy means no RAW fish, but grilled salmon is cooked and therefore fine. (6) Dev's celiac means Thai peanut noodles (typically wheat-based) are problematic for gluten reasons in addition to the peanut issue for Nina.

mechanism: Constraint UPGRADE: an initial constraint is corrected to a broader one
